primitives.name: Motion Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: His other known outputs use Mock Draft Database probabilities (probability matrix from 79 mock drafts, each team's probabilities summing to 1) and consensus-board "reach factor" vs actual draft slot — simple frequency/probability math on public inputs, supporting the view that he combines proprietary charting (FTN) with public PBP.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes clean tagging in nflverse PBP data; requires field-name verification for exclusions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High variance in small samples; prone to systematic bias if tagging protocols differ across teams.

layer2.mapping: Represents a discrete-state transition probability in a Markov chain of offensive formations; equivalent to a feature activation rate in machine learning.
layer2.telemetry: Observed frequency of motion events per offensive play, verifiable through nflverse PBP CSV exports.

primitives.name: Screen Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: His other known outputs use Mock Draft Database probabilities (probability matrix from 79 mock drafts, each team's probabilities summing to 1) and consensus-board "reach factor" vs actual draft slot — simple frequency/probability math on public inputs, supporting the view that he combines proprietary charting (FTN) with public PBP.
primitives.assumptions: Requires accurate screen-event tagging in PBP data; assumes all dropbacks are equally relevant.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Sensitive to definition of 'relevant pass/dropback' and may fail in high-tempo offenses.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a conditional probability of a screen play given a dropback event; used in GSI for offensive strategy assessment.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of screen plays to total dropbacks, extractable from nflverse PBP.

primitives.name: Play Action Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: His other known outputs use Mock Draft Database probabilities (probability matrix from 79 mock drafts, each team's probabilities summing to 1) and consensus-board "reach factor" vs actual draft slot — simple frequency/probability math on public inputs, supporting the view that he combines proprietary charting (FTN) with public PBP.
primitives.assumptions: Relies on correct PA-event tagging; assumes dropbacks are the baseline for comparison.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Vulnerable to misclassification errors in tagging; may spike artificially in certain game situations.

layer2.mapping: Represents the likelihood of a play being play-action given a dropback; central to GSE analysis of quarterback behavior.
layer2.telemetry: Fraction of play-action passes among all dropbacks, obtainable from nflverse PBP.

primitives.name: No-Huddle Rate
primitives.verbatim_quote: His other known outputs use Mock Draft Database probabilities (probability matrix from 79 mock drafts, each team's probabilities summing to 1) and consensus-board "reach factor" vs actual draft slot — simple frequency/probability math on public inputs, supporting the view that he combines proprietary charting (FTN) with public PBP.
primitives.assumptions: Requires accurate snap-level classification; assumes no-huddle status is stable across plays.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Prone to noise in short timeframes; may correlate spuriously with pace-of-game metrics.

layer2.mapping: Models the proportion of plays initiated in a no-huddle formation; applicable in GSI for tempo-based betting.
layer2.telemetry: Observed ratio of no-huddle snaps to total offensive snaps, available in nflverse PBP.
